metrics_policy.original_source_GT: immutable, official flat text string unchanged
metrics_policy.normalization: NFKC then remove all Unicode whitespace via str.isspace(), retaining punctuation, case and Simplified/Traditional glyph differences
metrics_policy.CER: Levenshtein substitutions/deletions/insertions over Unicode codepoints; per row numerator/reference denominator and aggregate sum(edit numerators)/sum(reference codepoints)
metrics_policy.strict_exact: normalized prediction equals normalized unchanged source GT; per-image success and completed-task success separate
metrics_policy.image_grounded_review: do not silently replace gold, repair typo, or strip correct tiny text to fit GT. Record visual disagreements/caveats separately; annotate reading order independently when flat official source does not provide unique block order.
metrics_policy.completion: raw suffix, EOS IDs, stop reason, token budget, truncation and unknown-ended flags preserved. Any truncated/unknown result cannot count as completed success.
